chapter: Advice to youth and the art of drumming
title: Showy drummers and drummers' status as musicians
summary: DeMichael and Saunders discuss how flash made it hard for drummers to be accepted as musicians.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, I guess it was because of things like that and, as much as I loved him, Gene Krupa, too, that --
-- that made it very difficult for musicians, or drummers to be accepted as a musician.
There are still guys that do that.
A fairly young drummer around town, Johnny Faren, --
-- who does all that crap. He goes out on the floor and plays on the floor --
Plays -- right, See, that was the thing then.
Saw him one time, he made me so mad. I was thinking about all the cats that don't do that and refuse to it, and trying --
(Unintelligible) seven piece band, wants six musicians and a drummer.
